category_edits.rationale: Apply a 0.1 pairwise ranking margin across all four datasets to encourage greater positive-negative separation. Retain the 0.2 pointwise coefficient, uniform valid-position averaging, and one GRU4Rec checkpoint per category.

response.change_summary: Add only a 0.1 margin to the pairwise loss. Architecture, predictor, sampling, optimizer, routing, and training settings remain unchanged.
